segments.environment: An indoor robotics showroom at night with full-height floor-to-ceiling glass windows revealing illuminated city buildings outside. A green artificial turf arena is enclosed by low white curved railings. Inside the turf arena are multiple robotic models: a white and grey ramp obstacle with stairs on the left where a dark humanoid robot sits; a metallic quadruped robot lying on the turf; a white piano with stool in the background; a large illuminated cylindrical display column in the center housing a standing humanoid robot under overhead ring lights; and an advertising roll-up banner on the right for 'GOGO 助行外骨骼'. A woman in a blue cardigan stands to my left in the foreground.
